reported.title: No debounce: every bounce edge toggles the lamp
reported.description: The loop reads the raw pin and calls flipLamp() on every HIGH-to-LOW transition (lines 50-56) with no settle window, so each bounce edge counts as a press. Measured evidence shows a single press at 500 ms toggled D11 5 times, and bouncy presses produced 4 toggles each, far from the required exactly one. The 40 ms debounce/settle window required by the spec is never implemented anywhere in the firmware. 6 of 6 press(es) did not toggle D11 exactly once; toggle counts per press were [5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5]. D11 also toggled 24 time(s) with no press to explain it, first at 902 ms.

judge_input.spec:
- Momentary wall switch on D5 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); foyer lamp driver on D11.
- Each settled press toggles the lamp exactly once within 150 ms; releasing the switch must not toggle.
- Contact bounce up to 20 ms on press and release must not produce extra toggles.
- Debounce / settle window of 40 ms before accepting a press edge.
- Every 1500 ms print `foyer lamp=ON` or `foyer lamp=OFF`.
- Idle (unpressed) switch reads HIGH; a physical press is a HIGH-to-LOW transition after settle.
